correctness.rationale: The explicitly specified two-qubit generator evolves the Bell reset state to an X-state with known exponentially decaying populations and coherence. Poisson regenerative averaging yields exact rational entries. Pauli correlations diagonalize to u,-u,v; the CHSH criterion reduces to two inequalities. The quintic has coefficient signs +,+,-,-,-,- for all b≥1 and one positive root; monotonicity of v above sqrt(2) gives a unique witness switch; a rescaled polynomial gives the 2/3 exponent. X-state concurrence follows from Wootters spin-flip eigenvalues. Included standalone checker passed 491 independent numerical/exact-rational and symbolic assertions. The analytical proof, not sampling, covers all quantified parameters.

value.rationale: For a natural two-qubit resource-maintenance experiment, the exact reset intensity needed for unfiltered Bell nonlocality is a motivated quantity distinct from concurrence. The result gives an exhaustive positive-rate phase diagram, identifies a sharp switch in which pair of Pauli singular values controls CHSH recovery, and proves a nontrivial 2/3 recovery-rate scaling at strong dephasing compared with the 1/2 entanglement scaling. It is not a mere renamed algebraic formula or arbitrary parameter slice; no experimental performance claims are made.
